newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: HK man arrested in $25 mln Philippine drug haul.
newsitem.headline: HK man arrested in $25 mln Philippine drug haul.

text.p: Police have arrested a Hong Kong Chinese man and seized $25 million worth of morphine and metamphetamine stimulants in one of the biggest seizures of illegal drugs in the Philippines, officials said on Wednesday.

National police chief Recaredo Sarmiento said his troops confiscated the drugs on Tuesday evening when they raided a house in nearby Tagaytay city, Cavite province, used as a storage by the suspect, whom he identified as Wai Kuen Alan Tong, 31.

The man, in handcuffs, did not make any statement when Interior Secretary Robert Barbers and Sarmiento presented him to media along with the 200 plastic bags of drugs police said they found in his house.
Cavite governor Epimaco Velasco earlier told reporters the man was a Taiwanese and that the drugs seized had a street value of 800 million pesos ($30 million).
Velasco did not identify the man and he could not be immediately reached for comment on the police report.
The seized drugs included about 200 kgs (440 lbs) of methamphetamine hydrochloride, also known as "ice", and 1,400 grams (49 ounces) of morphine-based pure heroin, an official police report said.
It said the seizure "is probably the single biggest drug bust" in the country in more than two decades.

Earlier this year, police seized 140 kgs (310 lbs) of methamphetamine stimulants from a suspected Chinese trafficker. They later set ablaze the drugs in a ceremony at a crematorium but ended up accidentally setting the crematorium itself on fire, damaging it.
